$comment: Human-maintained prose consumed by scripts/generate-exercise-catalog-doc.js. Only descriptions live here; the legal vocabulary itself is the taxonomy block inside assets/exercises/exercises.json, and the muscle-map slug set is TRAINABLE_SLUGS in lib/muscle-activation.ts. Keep these notes current when the meaning of an axis changes; the generator fails (independently of this file) when the DATA uses a value not declared in the taxonomy.

bodyRegions.upper: Upper body — chest, back, shoulders, arms.
bodyRegions.lower: Lower body — legs and the hip/thigh/calf groups.

muscleGroups.back: Pulls, rows, spinal-erector work (incl. good-morning, back extension, rack pull — treated as back).
muscleGroups.legs: Legs (compound) — general multi-joint leg work (squats, leg press, lunges, conventional + trap-bar deadlift, step-ups, jumps, sled, and running/cycling cardio).
muscleGroups.quads: Quad isolation (leg extension, sissy squat, wall sit).
muscleGroups.hamstrings: Hamstring-dominant (RDL, stiff-leg DL, leg curls, Nordic curl).
muscleGroups.glutes: Glute-dominant (hip thrust, glute bridge, sumo deadlift, pull-through, KB swing, abduction, kickbacks).
muscleGroups.adductors: Inner-thigh dominant (hip adduction, Copenhagen plank, lateral/Cossack squats & lunges).
muscleGroups.abs: Rectus abdominis / anterior core (incl. isometric holds like plank, levers).
muscleGroups.obliques: Lateral core / rotation / anti-rotation (side plank, Russian twist, woodchop, Pallof).

categories.strength: Resistance / weightlifting, including isometric holds. The strength-vs-cardio focus split counts this (and power) as strength.
categories.endurance: Steady-state cardio / locomotion (run, bike, row, swim, jump rope, elliptical, stair climber, walk, hike). Counts as cardio in the focus split.
categories.conditioning: Higher-intensity metabolic work (burpee, mountain climber, battle rope, sled push, bear crawl). Counts as cardio in the focus split.
categories.mobility: Flexibility / range-of-motion drills (stretches, dynamic mobility). Excluded from the strength-vs-cardio split.
categories.power: Explosive / ballistic work (Olympic lifts, jumps & plyometrics, KB swing). Counts as strength in the focus split.

dashboardAccess.summary: The dashboard treats the catalog as a read-only reference when assigning exercises into a plan. It MAY create user-scoped custom exercises, which must satisfy the same integrity rules as the catalog (see below). It must NOT silently invent classification or activation values outside the declared vocabulary.

fields.id: system — kebab-case, unique. Custom (user-created) exercises use the USER_CREATED_CUSTOM_ID convention; never collide with a catalog id.
fields.name: coach-edit — English display name.
fields.nameEs / videoUrlEs: coach-edit — Spanish name + technique video; required for catalog exercises (kept at 100% coverage in exercise_es_overrides.json).
fields.bodyRegion / muscleGroup / movementType: coach-edit, but constrained to the declared taxonomy. muscleGroup must belong to its bodyRegion.
fields.equipment: coach-edit — only tokens from the equipment vocabulary.
fields.muscleActivation: coach-edit, but every slug must be a TRAINABLE_SLUG and level 1-3. If omitted, the app falls back to MUSCLE_GROUP_TO_SLUGS[muscleGroup] at level 3 — so the muscle map always renders. Prefer explicit activation for accuracy.
fields.substitutionsRecommended: coach-edit — must reference real exercise ids.
